requirements.text: Design and operate distributed systems handling high request volume
Production experience writing backend services in Python or Go
Relational database schema design, query optimization, and migrations
Cloud infrastructure and container orchestration on AWS or GCP
Owning on-call rotation and production incident response
Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical design reviews
Responding to customer tickets with clear written communication
De-escalating frustrated customers and handling refund decisions
Working in a helpdesk platform such as Zendesk or Intercom
Writing and maintaining internal help center documentation
